args:
Fix OnboardingStyle card layout to show full style images without cropping. The new style images are 175x306px (portrait 1:1.75 ratio) but currently only the top portion shows due to fixed height container with object-cover.

  File to modify: apps/web/components/onboarding/OnboardingStyle.tsx

  Current issue in the image container (around line 116):
  - Fixed height: h-[110px] sm:h-[140px]
  - object-cover object-top crops the image

  Solution: Change the image section to use aspect-ratio instead of fixed height to display the full portrait image. Update the styling:
  1. Remove the fixed height from the image container div
  2. Use aspect-[175/306] or aspect-[7/12] to maintain the portrait ratio
  3. Keep object-cover to fill the aspect ratio container properly
  4. Optionally adjust the overall card min-height if needed for consistent layout

  The goal is to show the full body fashion images (not just head/shoulders) while maintaining a clean grid layout. The text section below the image should still be visible with style name, description, and card description.
